test_title: PYST 15: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 16th Sep 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Convert the following into indirect speech:

They said, “We are attending the conference.”

options.text: They said they are attending the conference.
They said that they were attending the conference.
They said they had attended the conference.
They said they attend the conference.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** They said that they were attending the conference.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **Tense Change:** "are attending" (present continuous) becomes "were attending" (past continuous) in indirect speech.
 
• **Pronoun Change:** "We" becomes "they".
 
• **Reporting Structure:** Quotation marks are removed, and "that" is introduced.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *They said that they were attending the conference.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** No tense change ("are attending" should be "were attending" in indirect speech).
 
• **Option 3:** Incorrect tense ("had attended" is past perfect, which changes the meaning).
 
• **Option 4:** Incorrect tense ("attend" is simple present, which changes the meaning).
